name: Spin
description: A stationary bike ride: the clock, your heart rate, and a FIT file that says indoor cycling rather than a bike ride that covered no ground. Uses a paired chest strap when one is connected and the wrist sensor when it is not.

configFields.label: Auto lap
configFields.description: Split the ride into laps this many minutes apart, with a buzz at each one. 0 records the ride as a single lap.

configFields.label: Target time
configFields.description: Buzz once when the ride reaches this many minutes, and say so on the screen. 0 for no target.

configFields.label: Keep the screen lit
configFields.description: Hold the backlight on for the whole ride. With your hands on the bars the wrist-tilt gesture rarely fires, so a dark room means a dark clock. It costs battery, and a lit room does not need it.

configFields.label: Energy in kJ
configFields.description: Show energy as kilojoules instead of calories. This is dietary energy (1 kcal = 4.184 kJ), not the kJ of work a power meter reports — the watch cannot measure that. The saved file always records kcal.

configFields.label: Heart rate zones
configFields.description: How many zones to use, 2 to 8. Leave at 0 to use the zones already set on the watch. Setting a count needs the floors below filled in too.

configFields.label: Zone 1 from
configFields.description: Lowest heart rate in zone 1, in bpm. Zone 1 runs from here up to zone 2's floor.

configFields.label: Zone 2 from
configFields.description: Lowest heart rate in zone 2, in bpm. Zone 2 runs from here up to zone 3's floor.

configFields.label: Zone 3 from
configFields.description: Lowest heart rate in zone 3, in bpm. Zone 3 runs from here up to zone 4's floor.

configFields.label: Zone 4 from
configFields.description: Lowest heart rate in zone 4, in bpm. Zone 4 runs from here up to zone 5's floor.

configFields.label: Zone 5 from
configFields.description: Lowest heart rate in zone 5, in bpm. Zone 5 runs from here up to zone 6's floor.

configFields.label: Zone 6 from
configFields.description: Lowest heart rate in zone 6, in bpm. Zone 6 runs from here up to zone 7's floor.

configFields.label: Zone 7 from
configFields.description: Lowest heart rate in zone 7, in bpm. Zone 7 runs from here up to zone 8's floor.

configFields.label: Zone 8 from
configFields.description: Lowest heart rate in zone 8, in bpm. The top zone has no upper bound.
